Keyed OncoKB annotation with explicit tumor context and build.
Cancer Hotspots candidate residue counts; no established exact allele join or clinical actionability.

description: Read an rsID, CAid, clinvar:N, VCV accession, reference-qualified HGVS or VCF-style genomic coordinates such as 7-140753336-A-T through the shared resolver. MyVariant identity lookups default to GRCh38; --build overrides it. Chromosome genomic HGVS requires --build. Use search variant --gene BRAF --protein V600E or search variant --gene PTEN --coding c.333G>T for coding changes. A gene and protein phrase such as BRAF V600E searches for checked allele candidates. With civic alone, use a CIViC profile ID or exact name. Every candidate remains available; source assertions do not classify the variant for the caller.

Kind; help get variant
Kind
